name.en: Fake Belize Tax Service relief page offering a new tax amnesty

how.en: A Facebook page presents itself as a government office and offers small businesses a new extension of the MSME tax amnesty or tax relief. It asks business owners to apply through the page and share personal and business information. The Ministry of Investment says no such extension exists and nobody is authorised to run it.

text.en: A Facebook page that looks official offers tax relief or a new tax amnesty to small businesses.
It says places are limited or the deadline is close.
It asks you to apply through the page or a link and send business and personal details.
The details can be used for fraud, or to ask you for a fee later.

BTS MSME SUPPORT: Good news for small businesses! Tax Amnesty Phase 2 is now open. Penalties and interest written off 100%. Register your business before Friday by sending your TIN, ID and contact details to our inbox or apply here [link]

en: facebook page offering tax amnesty for small businesses
belize tax service relief hub page
apply for tax relief through a facebook page
page asking for my tin and business details
new tax amnesty phase announced on social media
A government tax programme is offered through a Facebook page or inbox.
It asks for your TIN, ID or business details by message.
It promises to wipe out penalties if you register quickly.
Don’t send information to the page.
Check any tax programme directly with the Belize Tax Service or the Ministry of Investment on their official channels.
Report the page to Facebook and warn other business owners.

sources.title: Scam Alert: Fake "Tax Amnesty 2.0" Page Targets Belizean Businesses
